title: Should You Choose ElevenLabs Video to Text for Searchable Video Transcripts?
markdown:
If your decision comes down to turning recorded video into text you can review, search, edit, and caption, ElevenLabs’ Video to Text offering is worth considering. Its Scribe workflow is presented for webinars, documentaries, vlogs, podcasts, lectures, and interviews, with speaker-labeled transcripts intended to help editors locate moments without manually scrubbing a timeline. [ElevenLabs Video to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/video-to-text)

Check your source files first. The service lists MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV video support, plus audio formats including WAV, MP3, and FLAC. It also lists text exports such as TXT, DOCX, and PDF, and caption formats SRT and VTT. [ElevenLabs Video to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/video-to-text) For multi-person recordings, the product page says it can provide up to 32 speaker labels and word-level timestamps; it also describes editable transcript segments and speaker assignments. [ElevenLabs Video to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/video-to-text)

Language and captioning needs are another useful filter. ElevenLabs states that Scribe supports 99+ languages and accents, and its product page describes automatic language detection, audio-event tagging, and timed SRT/VTT exports. [ElevenLabs Video to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/video-to-text)

Budget should be evaluated against your whole ElevenLabs usage, since the pricing page says credits are shared across products. The Free plan is listed at $0 per month with 10,000 credits, while Starter is listed at $6 per month with 30,000 credits; Speech to Text is listed at approximately 330 credits per minute. That makes a rough credit-based estimate—not a guarantee—important before processing a large back catalog. Prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. [ElevenLabs Pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Choose it when speaker labels, timestamped editing, flexible upload formats, and caption exports match your workflow. Review the current product and pricing pages before committing, especially if other ElevenLabs products will draw from the same credit pool. [ElevenLabs Video to Text](https://elevenlabs.io/video-to-text) [ElevenLabs Pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.
